name: Franklin County, ME
findings: Franklin County has 100 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Franklin County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Franklin County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list public events
observations.text: 2 religious organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 5 would.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through religious groups? Where else does that happen?
